notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.notes:
Fixed bug with completed compounds counter which would make you think that game is shorter than it is. Bug affected only purple compounds related achievements and appropriate Steam stats (you got achievements earlier than you should).
2 times more music.
Added various languages.

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.notes: We have added a lot of different languages during last days and fixed some bugs, but also we changed score system a bit. Now you get additional 500 points per each completed goal. Notice that 500 points will be directly added to the total score and not to the combo score. It is recommended (but not necessary) to start a new game.
